audience_segments.segment: Autonomous Agent Developers & Multi-Agent Framework Engineers
audience_segments.icp: Engineers building LangChain, Antigravity, OpenClaw, Hermes, or Claude Code agents requiring dynamic MCP tool discovery.
pain_vocabulary: phantom tools: tools listed in registry that fail immediately upon connection
stale capability drift: server was updated or removed upstream without notice
registry downtime blindspot: reliance on central registry without local/edge delta ledger
unverified remotes: HTTP/SSE remotes declared without verified TLS or uptime SLA
current_workarounds: Hardcoding tool lists into agent system prompts
Periodic ad-hoc cron jobs running registry scrapes
Try-catch fallbacks at runtime that waste 15-30s of inference latency on broken tools

substitute_failure_modes.direct_registry_scraping: Official registry provides no uptime guarantee, status changes (tombstones) are omitted from naive queries, and updates lack execution proofs.
substitute_failure_modes.manual_readme_curation: Doesn't scale across 650+ MCP servers and 500+ namespaces updating hourly.

audience_segments.icp: Platform leads managing data security, compliance, and outbound network access for corporate AI agents.
pain_vocabulary: namespace impersonation: publisher names mimicking official brands
provenance opacity: unknown source repo or unsigned binary distribution
privilege escalation via uninspected MCP server updates
current_workarounds: Strict static IP/domain whitelists, prohibiting dynamic agent MCP discovery entirely.

substitute_failure_modes.static_whitelisting: Stifles agent productivity and breaks whenever cloud server IP pools rotate.
